result.summary: The screen is mostly well-formed. The horizontal carousels and the bottom-cut card are expected and were excluded. A few real defects remain: the bottom navigation is obscured by the system gesture bar and has no labels, the first 'Fastest near you' time badge overlaps its image, and the '-20%' promo card has no restaurant info.

issues.description: The system gesture/home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation. It cuts through the search icon and the orders icon, and the nav icons are partially clipped at the bottom edge. This makes the tabs harder to see and tap.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area/inset padding so the tab bar sits fully above the gesture bar, and make sure the icons are fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons have no text labels. The active state is indicated only by color, and the inactive icons are light grey with low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Add text labels under the icons and strengthen the inactive icon contrast and active-state indicator.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' cards, the time badge (e.g. '15–25 min') overlaps the plate image on the first card and sits over the food illustration. The badge placement looks inconsistent with the other cards' image framing, and the card image is low contrast against its light grey background.
issues.suggestion: Position badges consistently in a clear area of the image, and give the light card images a background or border that separates them from the page.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the pizza card is a dark translucent circle over a brown image with low contrast. The white '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges also sit over busy imagery.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque button background or a subtle shadow so the favorite control and badges stay legible over any image.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circles are clipped in the lower right, and the darker green corner looks like a rendering artifact rather than an intentional shape.
issues.suggestion: Tidy the decorative shapes so they blend with the banner, or remove them.
